==Overview==

* The following has been donated to the Imperial treasury:
** 10 thrones donated to the treasury by '''Lord Colwyn de Rondel''' to fund [[Ratify treaty with the Iron Confederacy|maps for the Iron Confederacy]]

===Commissions===
A total of '''10''' [[commission|commissions]] were announced during the Summer Solstice: 
* 8 standard commissions: [[Fortify Lower Tarn Valley II|Holt of the Oak]], [[Construct Georgies' Home for Goodest Dogs|Georgies' Home for Goodest Dogs]], [[Construct Kalpaheim Tradehall|Kalpaheim Tradehall]], [[Construct Mithril Block|the Block]], [[Construct Quartermaster's ministry|Quartermaster's ministry]], [[Construct repairs to Heliopticon|Heliopticon repairs]]* [[Construct Sarcombe Register II|Sarcombe Register]], [[Construct Zemress seminary|Zemress Seminary]]
* 3 wayleaves: [[Construct_Emilio's_Herbarium|Emilio's Herbarium]], [[Construct Freya's Garden|Freya's Garden]], and [[Construct_the_Hearth_of_Virtue|Hearth of Virtue]].

==Announcements==
* [[The_Throne#The_Hand_of_the_Chancellor|Hand of the Chancellor]] was exercised by [[Empress Lisabetta|Imperatrix Lisabetta]] to the amount of 350 Thrones.
* Announcement by Palerictus Krunk, [[bearer of an Imperial Wayleave]], of their intent to [[Construct Emilio's Herbarium]].
* Announcement by Nikolovich Drakov, [[bearer of an Imperial Wayleave]], of their intent to [[Construct the Hearth of Virtue]].
* Announcement by Tyr Brennan, [[bearer of an Imperial Wayleave]], of their intent to [[Construct Freya's Garden]].
* The [[Quartermaster General of the Imperial Armies]] announced that the Imperial Guerdon for Winter 382YE will be shared between the Green Shield, Quiet Step, Strong Reeds, Wolves of War, Hounds of Glory, and the [[Unleashing_the_storm#Beorath|raid to free Grendel slaves]] from Beoraidh.
* The [[Quartermaster General of the Imperial Armies]] is [[Resupply Announcement Winter 382YE|resupplying the Valiant Pegasus and the Seventh Wave]].
* The [[Advisor on the Vallorn]] announced plans to [[Research the life of Drustan]].
* The [[Minister of Historical Research]] announced plans to [[Research Sungold Pass]].
